UserSubscriptionRecord.title: UserSubscriptionRecord
UserSubscriptionRecord.description: Represents a synchronized YouTube subscription entry for a user.

channelId.description: Unique identifier of the subscribed YouTube channel.

channelTitle.description: Display title of the YouTube channel.

channelAvatarUrl.description: Avatar thumbnail URL for the channel.

subscribedAt.description: Timestamp when the channel was subscribed.

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether upload notifications are enabled for this channel.

unreadCount.description: Unread videos count for this subscription.

lastSyncedAt.description: Timestamp of the last sync operation.

/users/{userId}/subscriptions/{channelId.description: User subscribed channels synchronized with Firebase Firestore.
